name: Agent Web & Security Intelligence
description: Pay-per-call HTTP APIs for AI agents: public webpage extraction, website security preflight, and deterministic business-document analysis.

services.name: Webpage Extractor
services.useWhen: You already have a public webpage URL and need clean text, metadata, headings and links.

services.name: Website Security Preflight
services.useWhen: You need a fast first-pass security signal for a public website.

services.name: Vendor Security Preflight
services.useWhen: You need a fast first-pass vendor-risk signal from a public website before deeper review.

services.name: Business Document Analyzer
services.useWhen: You need deterministic structured triage of business-document text.
